narrow_obstruction: For tested solid clipped initial domains L=2,3,4,10,40, the literal inside-domain count has 4L occupied degree-two corners, no inside vacant sites, no cleanup after deleting one such corner, and masked raw rate 2L. Lemma7/8.14 cannot be imported from that count without an additional correction. This is a local counting issue, not a disproof of Theorem2 or a literature-status claim.
weighted_candidate: w_L(v)=L+2-norm1(v) is >=1 on clippedDomain. Every omitted birth of a supported state lies on norm1=L+2, so its weighted correction is exactly zero. Kernel proof draft is separate. Weighted contour O(L) drift and weighted exit Omega(L^3) threshold remain unproved.
all_L_formula_status: The record certifies only the five exact finite computations. The apparent formulas 4L, 4(L-1), and 2L have not been proved for all L by Lean in this stage. The general zero-weight forbidden-birth result is separately kernel-checked in ForbiddenBirthControl.lean.
